checkpoint.weights_loader: Official TabICL uses torch.load(weights_only=True); no pickled foreign model class.

selection: Fixed alpha0.5 primary; full alpha1 diagnostic only. No choosing a model or alpha on outer outcomes. Whole H1/Orion/CD4 exclusions; global target-hash20% withheld from all source fitting/basis labels. Same allowed source response tokens at query.
labels: Own-coordinate-excluded least-squares program coefficients; no own-target expression supplied. Source missing outputs restricted to shared measured axis, others fall back to V24.
gate: Primary TabICL MSE<=0.99, MAE<=0.995 vs V24; worst-family MSE<=1.02; better than identity-shuffled TabICL on both. CatBoost and ridge are matched descriptive controls, cannot replace a failed primary after outer scoring.
scope: Small-budget512-row8-program pilot of tabular foundation modeling, not exhaustive family tuning or published VCC score. Reused public biology. No reserve/package/upload.
